name: gta6-meme-x-01
description: The meme shows a cobwebbed skeleton gamer who has been waiting at his desk since 2013 as the calendar flies to 2026 over a Vice City / Leonida sunset, beside make.fun’s ghost mascot holding its star coin because the poster’s AI agent already got paid on make.fun. This repository hands the post’s address to the grader through `POST.json` and `main.ts`.
